title: بسبوسة ضد القط زيكو.. سر المصباح المرعب! 🧞😱
opening_line: الشرار بيطلع من عين زيكو السحرية

scenes.narration: الشرار بيطلع من عين زيكو السحرية!
scenes.image_prompt: Action scene in a narrow dark old Cairo alley. Basbusa, a cute female cartoon cat wearing a blue scarf, steps back with wide terrified eyes. In front of her, A large magical one-eyed cat spirit wearing a traditional Egyptian galabiya shoots glowing magical sparks from his single eye mid-animation.

scenes.narration: القط زيكو اشترط على بسبوسة تفرط في حارتها مقابل الأمان.
scenes.image_prompt: Close-up in the night alley. A large magical one-eyed cat spirit wearing a traditional Egyptian galabiya smirks maliciously, pointing his glowing paw at Basbusa, a female cartoon cat with a blue scarf, offering a dangerous bargain.

scenes.narration: بسبوسة رفضت بشجاعة ورمت عليه المصباح عشان تفرك السحر.
scenes.image_prompt: Dynamic scene where Basbusa, a female cartoon cat with a blue scarf, courageously hurls a glowing brass magical lamp right at A large magical one-eyed cat spirit wearing a traditional Egyptian galabiya.

scenes.narration: زيكو اتعصب وفتح طاقة المصباح السودا تسحب كل حاجة.
scenes.image_prompt: Dramatic view of the dark ancient Egyptian alley. The magic lamp bursts open on the cobblestones, unleashing a swirling dark magical vortex that pulls dust, crates, and shadows inward while A large magical one-eyed cat spirit wearing a traditional Egyptian galabiya laughs furiously.

scenes.narration: المصباح اتكسر وظهر جوا القاع سر خطير بيغير كل اللعبة.
scenes.image_prompt: The magic lamp snaps open in half, emitting a blinding golden light from its deep core, revealing a mysterious ancient glowing cat seal glowing brilliantly on the ground.

scenes.narration: السر القديم اتكشف قدام عيون بسبوسة المصدومة. انتظروا الجزء التالت! ومين اللي يقدر ينقذها من الشرار ده؟
scenes.image_prompt: Basbusa, the female cartoon cat wearing a blue scarf, stares in utter shock at the glowing revelation inside the broken lamp as magical sparks surround the dark alley. Dramatic atmospheric lighting.

cliffhanger: انكشاف سر قديم من قاع المصباح المكسور بيهدد حارة بسبوسة كلها

state.goal: النجاة من فخ زيكو وكشف سر المصباح
